name: amicode
description: Open autonomous research in VS Code — vaults, fleet, and live solves for quantum control and physical intelligence.

commands.title: Amicode: Open Chat Deck (Panes in One Tab)
Amicode: Set up a personal vault
Amicode: Save pulse from current run
Amicode: Fleet — Go Standalone (leave fleet, run locally)
Amicode: Open Amicode Terminal (vendored opencode, fleet-aware)

amicode.defaultModel.description: Default model for new chats, as "provider/model-id" (e.g. "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5", "opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free"). Empty = auto (a model in your global ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json if set, else a sensible fallback from your available credentials). The in-chat model picker still overrides per session.

amicode.inspector.autoOpen.description: Automatically reveal the Run Inspector panel when a solve starts (default off, so a starting solve never steals focus). Leave off to open it on demand — the status-bar item or the "Amicode: Open Run Inspector" command. Turn on to have a starting solve reveal the panel automatically.

amicode.opencodeBinary.description: Override path to the opencode CLI (dev only). Empty = use the vendored binary.

amicode.devAssetRoot.description: Override the extension's resource root for scores, templates, and bin/ (dev only). Empty = use the installed extension path. Set via the Developer Tools section in settings.

amicode.opencodePort.description: Fixed port for the spawned opencode server. Set to 0 to pick a free ephemeral port on each start instead.

amicode.juliaProject.description: Julia project (--project) the agent passes to amico-run. Empty = defaults to ~/.amico/julia (the provisioned project).

amicode.cloudUrl.description: Base URL of the Amico cloud Solve Service. "Amico: Connect Cloud" submits it with your API key to the local Amico server, which validates and stores both (~/.amico/cloud.json, where RemoteExecutor reads them). Empty = the built-in production endpoint (DEFAULT_CLOUD_URL in cloud_key.ts — the single source).

amicode.runsRoot.description: Runs root the inspector watches. Empty = ~/.amico/runs/default (must match where amico-run writes).

amicode.labToml.description: Path to the lab.toml hardware profile, validated on load. Empty = ~/.amico/lab.toml (where install.sh writes the starter).

amicode.skillRoots.description: Roots to search for co-located package skills (<Pkg>.jl/skills/<name>/SKILL.md). Empty = ~/harmoniqs/packages. First root containing a package's skills wins.

amicode.skillLibraryRoots.markdownDescription: Roots for the central skill library, scanned first-root-wins by directory name. Empty = the defaults: the dev's private plugin checkout (admits `surface: public` **and** `internal`), then the vendored public bundle (admits `public` only). Entries are typed roots `{"path": "...", "surfaces": ["public", ...]}` or plain strings. **Back-compat (ADR-0003):** a plain string keeps the pre-typing behavior — it admits `surface: public` only; existing string overrides keep working unchanged. Untagged/malformed skills are dropped from every root with a logged warning.

amicode.vaultDir.description: Personal Armonia vault for the user-memory substrate (profile, problem cards, pulse bank). Empty = auto-resolve the first kind=personal mount under ~/.amico/vaults.

amicode.distillerModel.description: Model (providerID/modelID) for the headless distiller agent. Pinned separately from the chat model so distillation survives provider rate limits.

amicode.veloce.description: Amico Veloce: start sessions with autonomy on — auto-accept high-confidence downstream recommendations without asking. Resource gates (solve launch, hardware) always confirm; any interruption drops veloce. Off by default.

amicode.chat.autoOpen.description: Open the Amicode chat automatically once the opencode server is ready.

amicode.device.name.description: Device to show in the Device Inspector (Spec A §3). Empty = the Device Inspector stays dormant. Ops state is read from ~/.amico/amicode/devices/<name>/state.json.

amicode.device.graph.description: Path to the device's calibration graph.toml (Spec A §4). Empty = the Device Inspector stays dormant.

amicode.device.card.description: Path to the device card markdown (Spec A §3.1) whose frontmatter carries drive_lines + qubits. Empty = qubits are derived from the graph and no drive lines are shown.

amicode.device.endpoint.description: Base URL of the QICK job-server (queue/health/config-versioning, Spec A §2). A pointer only, never credentials. Empty = the queue reads idle and drive lines read offline.

amicode.telemetry.enabled.description: Capture agent runs to Harmoniqs' internal run corpus (OpenTelemetry). Runs include your prompts and tool output, which may contain source code. On by default, but NOTHING is transmitted until ALL of: you answer the first-run consent prompt, an endpoint is configured (amicode.telemetry.endpoint), and your Amico cloud connection is set up ("Amico: Connect Cloud") — capture authenticates with your per-user cloud token. Turn off to disable capture entirely.

amicode.telemetry.endpoint.description: Base URL of the run-corpus ingest endpoint (no trailing slash; opencode appends /v1/traces and /v1/logs). Defaults to the PRODUCTION corpus. Empty = capture stays dormant even with consent given. Auth uses your per-user Amico cloud token (~/.amico/cloud.json, set up via "Amico: Connect Cloud") — never a separate ingest key. The token MUST be minted in the same AWS account as this endpoint: each account's credentials table is independent, so a token from the other account is rejected on every batch (401) while capture still looks enabled. This default is therefore account-coupled with DEFAULT_CLOUD_URL in cloud_key.ts — change both together or neither.

scripts.package: pnpm --filter @amicode/amico-run build && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:exemplars && pnpm run fetch:opencode && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o amicode.vsix
